issues.summary: The code or comment at this line is unclear, and the reviewer asks what it means.

The reviewer asks whether the design tradeoff is right: an explicit pass that creates delayed tensors only when they are needed, versus an implicit design where delayed tensors are always created and materialized when used.
Nit: the explicitly passed shape could be dropped in favor of the returned tensor's shape, with a clear error if the two don't match.
The code uses a generator but never relies on it being lazy; it should just build a list.
This value could be computed during the earlier full traversal instead of in a separate pass.
The rule silently assumes defer_input_idx is 0; it should either assert defer_input_idx == 0 or take a grad_input_idx parameter.
